+      - name: Checkout trusted producer
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          github-server-url: http://192.168.50.80:3000
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 1
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Checkout candidate source without credentials
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          github-server-url: http://192.168.50.80:3000
+          repository: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+          path: candidate-source
+          fetch-depth: 1
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Prepare Node and pnpm
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export PNPM_HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/pnpm"
+          mkdir -p "$PNPM_HOME"
+          echo "$PNPM_HOME" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+          export PATH="$PNPM_HOME:$PATH"
+          scripts/ci/activate-pnpm.sh 10.33.2
+          test "$(pnpm --version)" = "10.33.2"
+
+      - name: Install restore-only Cluster CI Cache CLI
+        uses: ./.forgejo/actions/setup-cluster-ci-cache
+
+      - name: Compute exact checked asset key
+        id: assets
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          echo "key=$(scripts/ci/api-assets-cache-key.sh candidate-source)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Restore trusted pnpm store
+        id: pnpm_cache
+        env:
+          CI_CACHE_NAMESPACE: spotlessbinco-pr-v5
+        uses: ./.forgejo/actions/cluster-pnpm-cache
+        with:
+          mode: restore
+          key: pnpm-store-v5-10.33.2-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('candidate-source/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
+
+      - name: Restore previously attested exact assets
+        id: asset_cache
+        uses: ./.forgejo/actions/cluster-directory-cache
+        with:
+          mode: restore
+          key: ${{ steps.assets.outputs.key }}
+          path: ${{ env.CI_CACHE_API_ASSETS }}
+
+      - name: Build exact API and UI outputs on a cache miss
+        if: env.CI_CACHE_DIRECTORY_HIT != 'true'
+        timeout-minutes: 30
+        env:
+          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096
+          PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD: 1
+          CYPRESS_INSTALL_BINARY: 0

+          set -euo pipefail
+          cd candidate-source
+          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --reporter=append-only

+          pnpm run generate:types
+          cd api
+          pnpm build
+          cd ..
+          pnpm run generate-ui-client
+          pnpm run generate-api-client:local-file

+          cd api
+          pnpm run copy-ui
+
+      - name: Stage immutable checked artifact
+        run: |

+          artifact="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/checked-assets"
+          source_root="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/candidate-source/api"

+            echo "::error::Checked artifacts must not contain symbolic links."
+            exit 1
+          fi

+          import hashlib
+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path
+
+          root = Path(os.environ["ARTIFACT_ROOT"])
+          files = sorted(
+              [path for name in ("dist", "public") for path in (root / name).rglob("*") if path.is_file()]
+              + [root / "rustyroad.toml"],
+              key=lambda path: path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
+          )
+          manifest = [
+              {
+                  "path": path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
+                  "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+              }
+              for path in files
+          ]
+          (root / "ASSETS.json").write_text(
+              json.dumps(manifest, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True) + "\n",
+              encoding="utf-8",
+          )
+          PY

+          test -s "$artifact/public/index.html"
+          test -s "$artifact/ASSETS.json"

+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import gzip
+          import os
+          import tarfile
+          from pathlib import Path
+
+          root = Path(os.environ["ARTIFACT_ROOT"])
+          archive = Path(os.environ["ARTIFACT_ARCHIVE"])
+          entries = sorted(root.rglob("*"), key=lambda path: path.relative_to(root).as_posix())
+          for path in entries:
+              if path.is_symlink() or not (path.is_dir() or path.is_file()):
+                  raise SystemExit(f"unsupported artifact entry: {path.relative_to(root)}")
+          with archive.open("wb") as raw_archive:
+              with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=raw_archive, mode="wb", compresslevel=1, mtime=0) as compressed:
+                  with tarfile.open(fileobj=compressed, mode="w") as bundle:
+                      for path in (entry for entry in entries if entry.is_file()):
+                          relative = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
+                          stat = path.stat()
+                          member = tarfile.TarInfo(relative)
+                          member.size = stat.st_size
+                          member.mode = 0o644
+                          member.mtime = 0
+                          with path.open("rb") as source:
+                              bundle.addfile(member, source)
+          PY
+          test -s "$ARTIFACT_ARCHIVE"
+
+      - name: Upload exact checked artifact
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
+        with:
+          name: checked-api-assets-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+          path: checked-assets.tar.gz
+          retention-days: 2
+          if-no-files-found: error
+
+  package:
+    name: Attest and package successful checked assets
+    needs: build_checked_assets
+    runs-on: spotlessbinco-k8s-dind-privileged
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      DOCKER_HOST: tcp://127.0.0.1:2375
+      CI_CACHE_SERVER: http://ci-cache-server.ci-cache.svc.cluster.local:8080
+      CI_CACHE_LAN_SERVER: http://192.168.50.82/ci-cache
+      CI_CACHE_NAMESPACE: spotlessbinco-trusted-v5
+      CI_CACHE_COMPRESSION: zstd
+      CI_CACHE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}
+      CI_CACHE_API_ASSETS: ${{ github.workspace }}/checked-assets
+      REGISTRY_URL: harbor-registry.container-registry.svc.cluster.local:5000
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout trusted producer
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          github-server-url: http://192.168.50.80:3000
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 1
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Checkout inert candidate source
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          github-server-url: http://192.168.50.80:3000
+          repository: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}
+          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+          path: candidate-source
+          fetch-depth: 1
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Download successful same-workflow artifact
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@v3
+        with:
+          name: checked-api-assets-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
+          path: checked-assets-transfer
+
+      - name: Extract checked artifact transfer safely
+        env:
+          ARTIFACT_ARCHIVE: ${{ github.workspace }}/checked-assets-transfer/checked-assets.tar.gz
+          ARTIFACT_ROOT: ${{ env.CI_CACHE_API_ASSETS }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import os
+          import shutil
+          import tarfile
+          from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
+
+          archive = Path(os.environ["ARTIFACT_ARCHIVE"])
+          root = Path(os.environ["ARTIFACT_ROOT"])
+          if root.exists():
+              raise SystemExit(f"artifact extraction root already exists: {root}")
+          root.mkdir(parents=True)
+          with tarfile.open(archive, "r:gz") as bundle:
+              members = bundle.getmembers()
+              if len(members) > 100_000 or sum(member.size for member in members) > 512 * 1024 * 1024:
+                  raise SystemExit("artifact archive exceeds the safe extraction limit")
+              recorded = set()
+              for member in members:
+                  relative = PurePosixPath(member.name)
+                  canonical = relative.as_posix()
+                  if (
+                      relative.is_absolute()
+                      or ".." in relative.parts
+                      or not relative.parts
+                      or member.name != canonical
+                  ):
+                      raise SystemExit(f"unsafe artifact archive path: {relative}")
+                  if canonical in recorded:
+                      raise SystemExit(f"duplicate artifact archive path: {relative}")
+                  recorded.add(canonical)
+                  if not member.isfile():
+                      raise SystemExit(f"artifact archive entry is not a regular file: {relative}")

+                      "rustyroad.toml",

+                  source = bundle.extractfile(member)
+                  if source is None:
+                      raise SystemExit(f"artifact archive file is unreadable: {relative}")

+                  destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

+                      shutil.copyfileobj(source, output)

+

+          test -s rustyroad.toml

+          import json
+          import os
+          from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
+
+          root = Path(os.environ["ARTIFACT_ROOT"])
+          manifest = json.loads((root / "ASSETS.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

+              path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
+              for name in ("dist", "public")
+              for path in (root / name).rglob("*")
+              if path.is_file()
+          } | {"rustyroad.toml"}

+              relative = PurePosixPath(entry["path"])

+

+            echo "API_STAGING_IMAGE_REPO=$project/spotlessbinco-api-staging"

+      - name: Verify candidate compatibility with protected producer
+        id: candidate

+          candidate_root="$trusted_root/candidate-source"
+          trusted_producer_key="$(scripts/ci/production-candidate-producer-key.sh)"

+            cd "$candidate_root"
+            "$trusted_root/scripts/ci/production-candidate-key.sh"
+          )"

Each module or source file must have one clear reason to change and must group behavior that belongs to the same domain responsibility. Prefer small, cohesive modules with explicit boundaries over large files organized only by technical type.
 
 ### Source File Size Limits
 
 - **80-line soft limit:** At 80 physical lines, treat the file as a refactoring signal. Before adding more code, evaluate whether distinct responsibilities, types, helpers, constants, or tests belong in focused sibling modules.

 ### JavaScript and TypeScript Standards
 
 - Use the repository's existing formatter and linter configuration (for example, Prettier, ESLint, or Biome where already configured). Do not introduce a competing formatter or override established project settings.

 - Keep imports formatter-compatible and organized according to the configured tooling. Remove unused imports and avoid broad barrel files that hide dependencies or create circular imports.
 - Use `camelCase` for functions and variables, `PascalCase` for classes, components, interfaces, and type aliases, and `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE` for true constants when consistent with the surrounding package.
 - Prefer named functions for reusable domain behavior and small components/hooks with a single purpose. Extract data access, orchestration, presentation, and state management into separate cohesive modules when they represent different reasons to change.
 - Avoid nested ternaries, implicit side effects, mutation across module boundaries, and formatting tricks used only to reduce line count. Favor explicit control flow and readable intermediate names.

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# Prints "<ref> <digest>" for the first image whose production-candidate label
+# equals the expected key. Missing refs and unlabeled refs are ignored.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   api-image-label-match.sh <expected-key> <image-ref>...
+
+expected_key="${1:?expected production candidate key is required}"
+shift || true
+
+image_manifest_digest() {
+  BUILDX_BUILDER=default timeout 20s docker buildx imagetools inspect "$1" \
+    --format '{{json .Manifest}}' 2>/dev/null | jq -er '.digest' 2>/dev/null || true
+}
+
+image_candidate_key() {
+  BUILDX_BUILDER=default timeout 20s docker buildx imagetools inspect "$1" \
+    --format '{{json .Image.Config.Labels}}' 2>/dev/null |
+    jq -er '."io.spotlessbinco.production-candidate-key" // empty' \
+      2>/dev/null || true
+}
+
+for ref in "$@"; do
+  [ -n "$ref" ] || continue
+  key="$(image_candidate_key "$ref")"
+  if [ "$key" != "$expected_key" ]; then
+    if [ -n "$key" ]; then
+      echo "Registry image ${ref} has nonmatching signature ${key}." >&2
+    else
+      echo "Registry image ${ref} has no production candidate signature." >&2
+    fi
+    continue
+  fi
+  digest="$(image_manifest_digest "$ref")"
+  if [ -n "$digest" ]; then
+    printf '%s %s\n' "$ref" "$digest"
+    exit 0
+  fi
+  echo "Registry image ${ref} matched but had no readable digest." >&2
+done

+# Prints an immutable production-candidate key for Fastify image inputs.
+# Workflow, documentation, and test-only commits intentionally reuse the same
+# checked image, while every file that can affect the packaged runtime changes
+# the key and forces the canonical production build on a candidate miss.

+name: Build Dev Rust Image
+
+# Called by deploy-dev.yml for trusted dev Rust image builds.
+on:
+  workflow_call:
+    inputs:
+      checkout_repository:
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+      checkout_ref:
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''

+        description: Exact cargo --version used to publish the binary cache
+        required: true
+        type: string

+        description: Exact rustc -vV used to publish the binary cache
+        required: true
+        type: string
+

+  group: dev-rust-cache

+          ref: ${{ inputs.checkout_ref || github.ref }}
+          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN || github.token }}

+      - name: Resolve backend image tag
+        id: tag
+        run: |
+          short_sha="$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)"
+          tag="dev-${short_sha}"
+          echo "tag=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "Backend dev tag: $tag"
+
+      - name: Resolve Harbor image refs
+        run: |
+          project="$REGISTRY_URL/spotlessbinco"
+          {
+            echo "BACKEND_IMAGE_REPO=$project/spotlessbinco"
+            echo "BASE_IMAGE=$project/base:latest"
+            echo "CACHE_REPO=$project/dev-cache"
+            echo "CI_CACHE_REGISTRY=$project"
+          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - name: Login to Quantum Forge registry
+        run: |
+          REGISTRY=${{ env.REGISTRY_URL }} \
+          REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME=${{ env.REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME }} \
+          REGISTRY_SECRET_NAMESPACES="spotlessbinco spotlessbinco-staging spotlessbinco-dev" \
+          scripts/vault-registry-login.sh
+
+      - name: Prepare trusted Harbor BuildKit builder
+        uses: ./.forgejo/actions/setup-harbor-buildx
+
+      - name: Configure trusted Rust BuildKit cache
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          cache_key="spotlessbinco/dev:buildcache-dev"
+          base_cache_key="spotlessbinco/base:buildcache-dev"
+          cache_from="$(ci-cache docker cache-from --key "$cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-from[ =]//")"
+          cache_to="$(ci-cache docker cache-to --key "$cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-to[ =]//")"
+          base_cache_from="$(ci-cache docker cache-from --key "$base_cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-from[ =]//")"
+          base_cache_to="$(ci-cache docker cache-to --key "$base_cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-to[ =]//")"
+          {
+            echo "DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_FROM_BRANCH="
+            echo "DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_FROM_MAIN=${cache_from}"
+            echo "DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_TO=${cache_to}"

+

+
+      - name: Rust image summary
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          outcome="${{ steps.rust-image.outcome }}"
+          echo "## Dev Rust image" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          echo "Build outcome: \`${outcome}\`" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          if [ "$outcome" = "success" ]; then
+            echo "Published backend: \

+              >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

+              >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          fi
+          echo "Commit: \`${{ github.sha }}\`" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

 # 
 # This uses the latest production image as base and just replaces the binary.
 # MUCH faster than a full build - just copies ~50MB binary and pushes.
 #
 # Requirements:
 #   - Run `make be` and wait for compilation to complete
 #   - Binary must exist at: target/release/launch-platform
 
 FROM registry.quantum-forge.net/spotlessbinco/spotlessbinco:latest
 
 # Cache buster - forces rebuild of layers below when timestamp changes
 # Pass via: docker build --build-arg CACHE_BUST=$(date +%s)
 ARG CACHE_BUST=1
 
 # Copy the new binaries from local build (overwrites the ones in the image)
 # Use release build instead of debug to avoid registry size limits.
 COPY target/release/launch-platform ./launch-platform
 COPY target/release/libtorch /opt/libtorch
 
 ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/libtorch/lib
 
 # Copy job_runner for cronjobs (SEO content, AEO fixer, etc.)
 COPY target/release/job_runner /usr/local/bin/job_runner

 CMD ["./launch-platform"]

+import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
+import {
+  exterior_quote_photosRepository,
+  exterior_quote_requestsRepository,
+  exterior_quote_surfacesRepository,
+} from '../db/drizzle/client.js';
+import { exterior_quote_requests } from '../db/drizzle/schema.js';
+import type { DrizzleDatabase } from '../db/drizzleDatabase.js';
+import type { InstantQuoteInput, InstantQuoteOutput } from './resultSchemas.js';
+import type { QuotePersistenceResult } from './repositoryTypes.js';
+
+type Surface = ReturnType<typeof import('./selectedPackageSurfaces.js').selectedPackageSurfaces>[number];
+type Photo = InstantQuoteInput['photos'][number];
+
+export async function findQuoteBySourceKey(db: DrizzleDatabase, sourceKey: string): Promise<QuotePersistenceResult | null> {
+  const [row] = await db.select({
+    id: exterior_quote_requests.id,
+    publicToken: exterior_quote_requests.public_token,
+  }).from(exterior_quote_requests)
+    .where(eq(exterior_quote_requests.source_key, sourceKey)).limit(1);
+  return row ? { id: Number(row.id), publicToken: row.publicToken, created: false } : null;
+}
+
+export async function insertQuoteRequest(
+  db: DrizzleDatabase,
+  input: InstantQuoteInput,
+  quote: InstantQuoteOutput,
+  sourceKey: string | null,
+): Promise<QuotePersistenceResult> {
+  if (!sourceKey) {
+    const row = await exterior_quote_requestsRepository.create(db, quoteRequestValues(input, quote, null));
+    return { id: row.id, publicToken: row.public_token, created: true };
+  }
+  const [row] = await db.insert(exterior_quote_requests)
+    .values(quoteRequestValues(input, quote, sourceKey))
+    .onConflictDoNothing({ target: exterior_quote_requests.source_key })
+    .returning({ id: exterior_quote_requests.id, publicToken: exterior_quote_requests.public_token });
+  return row ? { ...row, created: true } : await requireQuoteBySourceKey(db, sourceKey);
+}
+
+function quoteRequestValues(input: InstantQuoteInput, quote: InstantQuoteOutput, sourceKey: string | null) {
+  return {
+    first_name: input.contact.firstName ?? null, last_name: input.contact.lastName ?? null,
+    email: input.contact.email ?? null, phone: input.contact.phone,
+    line1: input.address.line1 ?? null, line2: input.address.line2 ?? null,
+    city: input.address.city ?? null, state: input.address.state,
+    postal_code: input.address.postalCode, problem_type: input.problemType,
+    status: quote.status, service_area: quote.serviceArea,
+    total_price_cents: quote.totalPriceCents,
+    line_items: quote.lineItems as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
+    blockers: quote.blockers, source_key: sourceKey,
+  };
+}
+
+async function requireQuoteBySourceKey(db: DrizzleDatabase, sourceKey: string): Promise<QuotePersistenceResult> {
+  const existing = await findQuoteBySourceKey(db, sourceKey);
+  if (existing) return existing;
+  throw new Error('Exterior quote source key conflict did not return an existing quote.');
+}
+
+export async function insertQuoteScope(
+  db: DrizzleDatabase,
+  quoteRequestId: number,
+  surfaces: Surface[],
+  photos: Photo[],
+): Promise<void> {
+  await Promise.all(surfaces.map((surface) => exterior_quote_surfacesRepository.create(db, {
+    quote_request_id: quoteRequestId, surface_type: surface.surfaceType,
+    size_sqft: surface.sizeSqft ?? null, quantity: surface.quantity ?? null,
+    stain_types: surface.stainTypes, risk_flags: surface.riskFlags,
+  })));
+  await Promise.all(photos.map((photo) => exterior_quote_photosRepository.create(db, {
+    quote_request_id: quoteRequestId, photo_type: photo.photoType, photo_url: photo.url,
+  })));
+}

+name: Build Dev Rust Image
+
+# Called by deploy-dev.yml for trusted dev Rust image builds.
+on:
+  workflow_call:
+    inputs:
+      checkout_repository:
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+      checkout_ref:
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+      rust_binary_cargo_version:
+        description: Exact cargo --version used to publish the binary cache
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      rust_binary_rustc_version:
+        description: Exact rustc -vV used to publish the binary cache
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+concurrency:
+  # One trusted writer owns the mutable dev cache ref.
+  group: dev-rust-cache
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+env:
+  REGISTRY_URL: registry.quantum-forge.net
+  REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME: registry-quantum-forge-net-credentials
+  SEMANTIC_TAG: dev-${{ github.sha }}
+

+  build-and-push:

+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      id-token: write

+      ENVIRONMENT: dev

+      RUST_BINARY_RUSTC_VERSION: ${{ inputs.rust_binary_rustc_version }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          github-server-url: https://forgejo.quantum-forge.io
+          repository: ${{ inputs.checkout_repository || 'riley/spotlessbinco' }}
+          ref: ${{ inputs.checkout_ref || github.ref }}
+          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN || github.token }}
+          fetch-depth: 1
+      - name: Resolve backend image tag
+        id: tag
+        run: |
+          short_sha="$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)"
+          tag="dev-${short_sha}"
+          echo "tag=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "Backend dev tag: $tag"
+
+      - name: Resolve Harbor image refs
+        run: |
+          project="$REGISTRY_URL/spotlessbinco"
+          {
+            echo "BACKEND_IMAGE_REPO=$project/spotlessbinco"
+            echo "BASE_IMAGE=$project/base:latest"
+            echo "CACHE_REPO=$project/dev-cache"
+            echo "CI_CACHE_REGISTRY=$project"
+          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - name: Login to Quantum Forge registry
+        run: |
+          REGISTRY=${{ env.REGISTRY_URL }} \
+          REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME=${{ env.REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME }} \
+          REGISTRY_SECRET_NAMESPACES="spotlessbinco spotlessbinco-staging spotlessbinco-dev" \
+          scripts/vault-registry-login.sh
+
+      - name: Prepare trusted Harbor BuildKit builder
+        uses: ./.forgejo/actions/setup-harbor-buildx
+
+      - name: Configure trusted Rust BuildKit cache
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          cache_key="spotlessbinco/dev:buildcache-dev"
+          base_cache_key="spotlessbinco/base:buildcache-dev"
+          cache_from="$(ci-cache docker cache-from --key "$cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-from[ =]//")"
+          cache_to="$(ci-cache docker cache-to --key "$cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-to[ =]//")"
+          base_cache_from="$(ci-cache docker cache-from --key "$base_cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-from[ =]//")"
+          base_cache_to="$(ci-cache docker cache-to --key "$base_cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-to[ =]//")"
+          {
+            echo "DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_FROM_BRANCH="
+            echo "DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_FROM_MAIN=${cache_from}"
+            echo "DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_TO=${cache_to}"

+            echo "BASE_BUILD_CACHE_TO=${base_cache_to}"
+          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+
+      - name: Build and push dev backend image only
+        id: rust-image

+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ff15f0306b3f739f7b6fd43fb5d26cd321bd4de5

+          if-no-files-found: warn
+
+      - name: Rust image summary
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          outcome="${{ steps.rust-image.outcome }}"
+          echo "## Dev Rust image" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          echo "Build outcome: \`${outcome}\`" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          if [ "$outcome" = "success" ]; then
+            echo "Published backend: \
+              \`${{ env.BACKEND_IMAGE_REPO }}:${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}\`" \
+              >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          else
+            echo "No final image was proven published by this run." \
+              >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          fi
+          echo "Commit: \`${{ github.sha }}\`" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

 # Dockerfile.prebuilt - Swap binary in existing production image
 # Usage: make bluegreen-prebuilt
 # 
 # This uses the latest production image as base and just replaces the binary.
 # MUCH faster than a full build - just copies ~50MB binary and pushes.
 #
 # Requirements:
 #   - Run `make be` and wait for compilation to complete
 #   - Binary must exist at: target/release/launch-platform
 
 FROM registry.quantum-forge.net/spotlessbinco/spotlessbinco:latest
 
 # Cache buster - forces rebuild of layers below when timestamp changes
 # Pass via: docker build --build-arg CACHE_BUST=$(date +%s)
 ARG CACHE_BUST=1
 
 # Copy the new binaries from local build (overwrites the ones in the image)
 # Use release build instead of debug to avoid registry size limits.
 COPY target/release/launch-platform ./launch-platform
 COPY target/release/libtorch /opt/libtorch
 
 ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/libtorch/lib
 
 # Copy job_runner for cronjobs (SEO content, AEO fixer, etc.)
 COPY target/release/job_runner /usr/local/bin/job_runner
 
 # Copy updated templates (src/views contains Tera templates)
 # This ensures new component templates are included without full rebuild
 COPY src/views ./src/views
 
+# Copy TetherScript payment/render workflows consumed by the Rust runtime
+COPY src/tetherscript ./src/tetherscript
+
 # Copy static files (CSS, JS tracker, images, icons)

 COPY static ./static
 
 # Same entrypoint as original
 CMD ["./launch-platform"]

+name: Build Dev Fastify API Image
+
+# Called by deploy-dev.yml for trusted dev API image builds.
+on:
+  workflow_call:
+    inputs:
+      checkout_repository:
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+      checkout_ref:
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+
+concurrency:
+  # One trusted writer owns the mutable dev cache ref.
+  group: dev-api-cache
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+env:
+  REGISTRY_URL: registry.quantum-forge.net
+  REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME: registry-quantum-forge-net-credentials
+

+  build-and-push-dev-api:

+    timeout-minutes: 120

+      id-token: write

+      NODE_ENV: development
+      ENVIRONMENT: dev
+      CI: 'true'
+      DOCKER_HOST: tcp://127.0.0.1:2375
+      DISABLE_STARTUP_INDEXES: 'true'
+      ENABLE_STARTUP_ROUTE_AWARENESS: 'false'
+      DISABLE_STARTUP_AB_ANALYTICS_REFRESH: 'true'
+      PLAYWRIGHT_APP_URL: http://localhost:8081
+      PLAYWRIGHT_AGENT_APP_URL: http://localhost:8081
+      PLAYWRIGHT_API_HOST: 127.0.0.1
+      PLAYWRIGHT_API_PORT: '8081'
+      PLAYWRIGHT_API_BASE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8081
+      CI_CACHE_SERVER: http://ci-cache-server.ci-cache.svc.cluster.local:8080
+      CI_CACHE_NAMESPACE: spotlessbinco-trusted-v5
+      CI_CACHE_COMPRESSION: zstd
+      CI_CACHE_ORPC_CONTRACT: /tmp/spotlessbinco-ci-cache-materialized/orpc-contract
+      CI_CACHE_API_ASSETS: /tmp/spotlessbinco-ci-cache-materialized/api-assets
+      CI_CACHE_PNPM_STORE: /tmp/spotlessbinco-ci-cache-materialized/pnpm/10.33.2
+      PLAYWRIGHT_API_CONTAINER: spotlessbinco-dev-api-integration
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          github-server-url: https://forgejo.quantum-forge.io
+          repository: ${{ inputs.checkout_repository || 'riley/spotlessbinco' }}
+          ref: ${{ inputs.checkout_ref || github.ref }}
+          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN || github.token }}
+          fetch-depth: 1
+
+      - name: Select reachable Cluster CI Cache service
+        uses: ./.forgejo/actions/setup-cluster-ci-cache
+
+      - name: Resolve API image tag
+        id: tag
+        run: |
+          short_sha="$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)"
+          tag="dev-${short_sha}"
+          echo "tag=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "Fastify dev tag: $tag"
+
+      - name: Resolve in-cluster Harbor image refs
+        run: |
+          project="$REGISTRY_URL/spotlessbinco"
+          {
+            echo "API_IMAGE_REPO=$project/spotlessbinco-api"
+            echo "CI_CACHE_REGISTRY=$project"
+          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+
+
+      - name: Detect changed migration SQL
+        id: changes
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          # Reading the dev ledger only matters when migration SQL moved.
+          # Compare against the pushed base so an unrelated revision skips the
+          # ledger gate. This stays offline: fetching would prompt
+          # for an unknown SSH host key and hang the job, so an unavailable base
+          # revision falls through to applying the chain.
+          base_sha="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before || '' }}"
+          if [ -z "$base_sha" ] || ! git rev-parse --verify "$base_sha^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+            base_sha="$(git rev-parse --verify 'HEAD~1' 2>/dev/null || true)"
+          fi
+          if [ -z "$base_sha" ]; then
+            echo "sql=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+            echo "No comparable base revision; checking the dev ledger."
+            exit 0
+          fi
+          if git diff --name-only "$base_sha" "${GITHUB_SHA:-HEAD}" \
+            -- 'config/database/migrations/**/*.sql' | grep -q .; then
+            echo "sql=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+            echo "Migration SQL changed; the dev ledger will be checked."
+          else
+            echo "sql=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+            echo "No migration SQL changed; skipping the database schema step."
+          fi
+

+          REGISTRY_SECRET_NAMESPACES="spotlessbinco spotlessbinco-staging spotlessbinco-dev" \

+

+
+      - name: Compute generated oRPC contract cache key
+        id: orpc_contract_key

+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail

+        id: orpc_contract_restore

+          CACHE_PATH: ${{ env.CI_CACHE_ORPC_CONTRACT }}

+        with:

+          path: ${{ env.CI_CACHE_ORPC_CONTRACT }}
+
+
+

+name: Build Dev Rust Image
+
+# Called by deploy-dev.yml for trusted dev Rust image builds.
+on:
+  workflow_call:
+    inputs:
+      checkout_repository:
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+      checkout_ref:
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+      rust_binary_cargo_version:
+        description: Exact cargo --version used to publish the binary cache
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      rust_binary_rustc_version:
+        description: Exact rustc -vV used to publish the binary cache
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+concurrency:
+  # One trusted writer owns the mutable dev cache ref.
+  group: dev-rust-cache
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+env:
+  REGISTRY_URL: registry.quantum-forge.net
+  REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME: registry-quantum-forge-net-credentials
+  SEMANTIC_TAG: dev-${{ github.sha }}
+
+jobs:
+  build-and-push:
+    runs-on: spotlessbinco-k8s-dind-privileged
+    timeout-minutes: 90
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      id-token: write
+    env:
+      NODE_ENV: development
+      ENVIRONMENT: dev
+      CI: 'true'
+      DOCKER_HOST: tcp://127.0.0.1:2375
+      CI_CACHE_SERVER: http://ci-cache-server.ci-cache.svc.cluster.local:8080
+      CI_CACHE_NAMESPACE: spotlessbinco-dev-v5

+      RUST_BINARY_CARGO_VERSION: ${{ inputs.rust_binary_cargo_version }}
+      RUST_BINARY_RUSTC_VERSION: ${{ inputs.rust_binary_rustc_version }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          github-server-url: https://forgejo.quantum-forge.io
+          repository: ${{ inputs.checkout_repository || 'riley/spotlessbinco' }}
+          ref: ${{ inputs.checkout_ref || github.ref }}
+          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN || github.token }}
+          fetch-depth: 1
+      - name: Resolve backend image tag
+        id: tag
+        run: |
+          short_sha="$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)"
+          tag="dev-${short_sha}"
+          echo "tag=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "Backend dev tag: $tag"
+
+      - name: Resolve Harbor image refs
+        run: |
+          project="$REGISTRY_URL/spotlessbinco"
+          {
+            echo "BACKEND_IMAGE_REPO=$project/spotlessbinco"
+            echo "BASE_IMAGE=$project/base:latest"
+            echo "CACHE_REPO=$project/dev-cache"
+            echo "CI_CACHE_REGISTRY=$project"
+          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - name: Login to Quantum Forge registry
+        run: |
+          REGISTRY=${{ env.REGISTRY_URL }} \
+          REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME=${{ env.REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME }} \
+          REGISTRY_SECRET_NAMESPACES="spotlessbinco spotlessbinco-staging spotlessbinco-dev" \
+          scripts/vault-registry-login.sh
+
+      - name: Prepare trusted Harbor BuildKit builder
+        uses: ./.forgejo/actions/setup-harbor-buildx
+
+      - name: Configure trusted Rust BuildKit cache
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          cache_key="spotlessbinco/dev:buildcache-dev"
+          base_cache_key="spotlessbinco/base:buildcache-dev"
+          cache_from="$(ci-cache docker cache-from --key "$cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-from[ =]//")"
+          cache_to="$(ci-cache docker cache-to --key "$cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-to[ =]//")"
+          base_cache_from="$(ci-cache docker cache-from --key "$base_cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-from[ =]//")"
+          base_cache_to="$(ci-cache docker cache-to --key "$base_cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-to[ =]//")"
+          {
+            echo "DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_FROM_BRANCH="
+            echo "DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_FROM_MAIN=${cache_from}"
+            echo "DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_TO=${cache_to}"
+            echo "BASE_BUILD_CACHE_FROM_MAIN=${base_cache_from}"
+            echo "BASE_BUILD_CACHE_TO=${base_cache_to}"
+          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+
+      - name: Build and push dev backend image only
+        id: rust-image
+        env:
+          NPM_QUANTUM_FORGE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_QUANTUM_FORGE_TOKEN }}
+          BACKEND_TAG: ${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}
+          BACKEND_ALIAS_TAG: dev
+          BUILDX_RESULT_MODE: push
+        run: |
+          echo "Building on the Kubernetes cluster runner with local BuildKit."
+          BASE_IMAGE="$BASE_IMAGE" \
+            bash scripts/ci/run-production-rust-image-build.sh
+
+      - name: Upload Rust image build diagnostics
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ff15f0306b3f739f7b6fd43fb5d26cd321bd4de5
+        with:
+          name: dev-rust-image-${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}
+          path: |
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/rust-image-build/build.log
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/rust-image-build/image-metadata.json
+          if-no-files-found: warn
+
+      - name: Rust image summary
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          outcome="${{ steps.rust-image.outcome }}"
+          echo "## Dev Rust image" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          echo "Build outcome: \`${outcome}\`" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          if [ "$outcome" = "success" ]; then
+            echo "Published backend: \
+              \`${{ env.BACKEND_IMAGE_REPO }}:${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}\`" \
+              >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          else
+            echo "No final image was proven published by this run." \
+              >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          fi
+          echo "Commit: \`${{ github.sha }}\`" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

 # Dockerfile.prebuilt - Swap binary in existing production image
 # Usage: make bluegreen-prebuilt
 # 
 # This uses the latest production image as base and just replaces the binary.
 # MUCH faster than a full build - just copies ~50MB binary and pushes.
 #
 # Requirements:
 #   - Run `make be` and wait for compilation to complete
 #   - Binary must exist at: target/release/launch-platform
 
 FROM registry.quantum-forge.net/spotlessbinco/spotlessbinco:latest
 
 # Cache buster - forces rebuild of layers below when timestamp changes
 # Pass via: docker build --build-arg CACHE_BUST=$(date +%s)
 ARG CACHE_BUST=1
 
 # Copy the new binaries from local build (overwrites the ones in the image)
 # Use release build instead of debug to avoid registry size limits.
 COPY target/release/launch-platform ./launch-platform
 COPY target/release/libtorch /opt/libtorch
 
 ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/libtorch/lib
 
 # Copy job_runner for cronjobs (SEO content, AEO fixer, etc.)
 COPY target/release/job_runner /usr/local/bin/job_runner
 
 # Copy updated templates (src/views contains Tera templates)

 COPY src/views ./src/views
 
+# Copy TetherScript payment/render workflows consumed by the Rust runtime

+
 # Copy static files (CSS, JS tracker, images, icons)

 COPY static ./static
 
 # Same entrypoint as original
 CMD ["./launch-platform"]

+export async function findQuoteBySourceKey(db: DrizzleDatabase, sourceKey: string): Promise<QuotePersistenceResult | null> {
+  const [row] = await db.select({
+    id: exterior_quote_requests.id,
+    publicToken: exterior_quote_requests.public_token,

+    .where(eq(exterior_quote_requests.source_key, sourceKey)).limit(1);
+  return row ? { id: Number(row.id), publicToken: row.publicToken, created: false } : null;

+export async function insertQuoteRequest(
+  db: DrizzleDatabase,

+  quote: InstantQuoteOutput,

+    .onConflictDoNothing({ target: exterior_quote_requests.source_key })

+name: Build Dev Rust Image
+
+# Called by deploy-dev.yml and production-candidate.yml for trusted dev Rust image builds.
+on:
+  workflow_call:
+    inputs:
+      checkout_repository:
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+      checkout_ref:
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+      rust_binary_cargo_version:
+        description: Exact cargo --version used to publish the binary cache
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      rust_binary_rustc_version:
+        description: Exact rustc -vV used to publish the binary cache
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+concurrency:
+  # One trusted writer owns the mutable dev cache ref.
+  group: dev-rust-cache
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+env:
+  REGISTRY_URL: registry.quantum-forge.net
+  REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME: registry-quantum-forge-net-credentials
+  SEMANTIC_TAG: dev-${{ github.sha }}
+
+jobs:
+  build-and-push:
+    runs-on: spotlessbinco-k8s-dind-privileged
+    timeout-minutes: 90
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      id-token: write
+    env:
+      NODE_ENV: development
+      ENVIRONMENT: dev
+      CI: 'true'
+      DOCKER_HOST: tcp://127.0.0.1:2375
+      CI_CACHE_SERVER: http://ci-cache-server.ci-cache.svc.cluster.local:8080
+      CI_CACHE_NAMESPACE: spotlessbinco-dev-v5
+      CI_CACHE_COMPRESSION: zstd
+      RUST_BINARY_CARGO_VERSION: ${{ inputs.rust_binary_cargo_version }}
+      RUST_BINARY_RUSTC_VERSION: ${{ inputs.rust_binary_rustc_version }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          github-server-url: https://forgejo.quantum-forge.io
+          repository: ${{ inputs.checkout_repository || 'riley/spotlessbinco' }}
+          ref: ${{ inputs.checkout_ref || github.ref }}
+          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN || github.token }}
+          fetch-depth: 1
+      - name: Resolve backend image tag
+        id: tag
+        run: |
+          short_sha="$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)"
+          tag="dev-${short_sha}"
+          echo "tag=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "Backend dev tag: $tag"
+
+      - name: Resolve Harbor image refs
+        run: |
+          project="$REGISTRY_URL/spotlessbinco"
+          {
+            echo "BACKEND_IMAGE_REPO=$project/spotlessbinco"
+            echo "BASE_IMAGE=$project/base:latest"
+            echo "CACHE_REPO=$project/dev-cache"
+            echo "CI_CACHE_REGISTRY=$project"
+          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - name: Login to Quantum Forge registry
+        run: |
+          REGISTRY=${{ env.REGISTRY_URL }} \
+          REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME=${{ env.REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME }} \
+          REGISTRY_SECRET_NAMESPACES="spotlessbinco spotlessbinco-staging spotlessbinco-dev" \
+          scripts/vault-registry-login.sh
+
+      - name: Prepare trusted Harbor BuildKit builder
+        uses: ./.forgejo/actions/setup-harbor-buildx
+
+      - name: Configure trusted Rust BuildKit cache
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          cache_key="spotlessbinco/dev:buildcache-dev"
+          base_cache_key="spotlessbinco/base:buildcache-dev"
+          cache_from="$(ci-cache docker cache-from --key "$cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-from[ =]//")"
+          cache_to="$(ci-cache docker cache-to --key "$cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-to[ =]//")"
+          base_cache_from="$(ci-cache docker cache-from --key "$base_cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-from[ =]//")"
+          base_cache_to="$(ci-cache docker cache-to --key "$base_cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-to[ =]//")"
+          {
+            echo "DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_FROM_BRANCH="
+            echo "DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_FROM_MAIN=${cache_from}"
+            echo "DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_TO=${cache_to}"
+            echo "BASE_BUILD_CACHE_FROM_MAIN=${base_cache_from}"
+            echo "BASE_BUILD_CACHE_TO=${base_cache_to}"
+          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+
+      - name: Build and push dev backend image only
+        id: rust-image
+        env:
+          NPM_QUANTUM_FORGE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_QUANTUM_FORGE_TOKEN }}
+          BACKEND_TAG: ${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}
+          BACKEND_ALIAS_TAG: dev
+          BUILDX_RESULT_MODE: push
+        run: |
+          echo "Building on the Kubernetes cluster runner with local BuildKit."
+          BASE_IMAGE="$BASE_IMAGE" \
+            bash scripts/ci/run-production-rust-image-build.sh
+
+      - name: Upload Rust image build diagnostics
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ff15f0306b3f739f7b6fd43fb5d26cd321bd4de5
+        with:
+          name: dev-rust-image-${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}
+          path: |
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/rust-image-build/build.log
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/rust-image-build/image-metadata.json
+          if-no-files-found: warn
+
+      - name: Rust image summary
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          outcome="${{ steps.rust-image.outcome }}"
+          echo "## Dev Rust image" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          echo "Build outcome: \`${outcome}\`" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          if [ "$outcome" = "success" ]; then
+            echo "Published backend: \
+              \`${{ env.BACKEND_IMAGE_REPO }}:${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}\`" \
+              >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          else
+            echo "No final image was proven published by this run." \
+              >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+          fi
+          echo "Commit: \`${{ github.sha }}\`" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

+import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
+import {
+  exterior_quote_photosRepository,
+  exterior_quote_requestsRepository,
+  exterior_quote_surfacesRepository,
+} from '../db/drizzle/client.js';
+import { exterior_quote_requests } from '../db/drizzle/schema.js';
+import type { DrizzleDatabase } from '../db/drizzleDatabase.js';
+import type { InstantQuoteInput, InstantQuoteOutput } from './resultSchemas.js';
+import type { QuotePersistenceResult } from './repositoryTypes.js';
+
+type Surface = ReturnType<typeof import('./selectedPackageSurfaces.js').selectedPackageSurfaces>[number];
+type Photo = InstantQuoteInput['photos'][number];
+
+export async function findQuoteBySourceKey(db: DrizzleDatabase, sourceKey: string): Promise<QuotePersistenceResult | null> {
+  const [row] = await db.select({
+    id: exterior_quote_requests.id,
+    publicToken: exterior_quote_requests.public_token,
+  }).from(exterior_quote_requests)
+    .where(eq(exterior_quote_requests.source_key, sourceKey)).limit(1);
+  return row ? { id: Number(row.id), publicToken: row.publicToken, created: false } : null;
+}
+
+export async function insertQuoteRequest(
+  db: DrizzleDatabase,
+  input: InstantQuoteInput,
+  quote: InstantQuoteOutput,
+  sourceKey: string | null,
+): Promise<QuotePersistenceResult> {
+  if (!sourceKey) {
+    const row = await exterior_quote_requestsRepository.create(db, quoteRequestValues(input, quote, null));
+    return { id: row.id, publicToken: row.public_token, created: true };
+  }
+  const [row] = await db.insert(exterior_quote_requests)
+    .values(quoteRequestValues(input, quote, sourceKey))
+    .onConflictDoNothing({ target: exterior_quote_requests.source_key })
+    .returning({ id: exterior_quote_requests.id, publicToken: exterior_quote_requests.public_token });
+  return row ? { ...row, created: true } : await requireQuoteBySourceKey(db, sourceKey);
+}
+
+function quoteRequestValues(input: InstantQuoteInput, quote: InstantQuoteOutput, sourceKey: string | null) {
+  return {
+    first_name: input.contact.firstName ?? null, last_name: input.contact.lastName ?? null,
+    email: input.contact.email ?? null, phone: input.contact.phone,
+    line1: input.address.line1 ?? null, line2: input.address.line2 ?? null,
+    city: input.address.city ?? null, state: input.address.state,
+    postal_code: input.address.postalCode, problem_type: input.problemType,
+    status: quote.status, service_area: quote.serviceArea,
+    total_price_cents: quote.totalPriceCents,
+    line_items: quote.lineItems as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
+    blockers: quote.blockers, source_key: sourceKey,
+  };
+}
+
+async function requireQuoteBySourceKey(db: DrizzleDatabase, sourceKey: string): Promise<QuotePersistenceResult> {
+  const existing = await findQuoteBySourceKey(db, sourceKey);
+  if (existing) return existing;
+  throw new Error('Exterior quote source key conflict did not return an existing quote.');
+}
+
+export async function insertQuoteScope(
+  db: DrizzleDatabase,
+  quoteRequestId: number,
+  surfaces: Surface[],
+  photos: Photo[],
+): Promise<void> {
+  await Promise.all(surfaces.map((surface) => exterior_quote_surfacesRepository.create(db, {
+    quote_request_id: quoteRequestId, surface_type: surface.surfaceType,
+    size_sqft: surface.sizeSqft ?? null, quantity: surface.quantity ?? null,
+    stain_types: surface.stainTypes, risk_flags: surface.riskFlags,
+  })));
+  await Promise.all(photos.map((photo) => exterior_quote_photosRepository.create(db, {
+    quote_request_id: quoteRequestId, photo_type: photo.photoType, photo_url: photo.url,
+  })));
+}

+import type Stripe from 'stripe';
+import { drizzleDb } from '../db/drizzleClient.js';
+import { stripe_payments } from '../db/drizzle/schema.js';
+
+type Result = { handled: boolean; success: boolean; error?: string };
+type Metadata = Record<string, string>;
+
+function textId(value: string | { id?: string } | null | undefined) {
+  if (typeof value === 'string') return value;
+  return typeof value?.id === 'string' ? value.id : null;
+}
+
+function numberFrom(metadata: Metadata, key: string) {
+  const value = metadata[key];
+  if (!value) return null;
+  const parsed = Number.parseInt(value, 10);
+  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
+}
+
+function productType(metadata: Metadata) {
+  return metadata.product_type ?? metadata.productType ?? 'one_time';
+}
+
+function priceType(metadata: Metadata) {
+  return metadata.price_type ?? (productType(metadata) === 'subscription' ? 'recurring' : 'one_time');
+}
+
+function createdAt(paymentIntent: Stripe.PaymentIntent) {
+  return new Date(paymentIntent.created * 1000).toISOString();
+}
+
+function values(paymentIntent: Stripe.PaymentIntent) {
+  const metadata = paymentIntent.metadata ?? {};
+  const amount = paymentIntent.amount_received || paymentIntent.amount;
+  return {
+    stripe_payment_intent_id: paymentIntent.id,
+    stripe_customer_id: textId(paymentIntent.customer),
+    stripe_charge_id: textId(paymentIntent.latest_charge),
+    stripe_checkout_session_id: metadata.checkout_session_id ?? null,
+    amount_cents: amount,
+    amount_refunded_cents: 0,
+    currency: paymentIntent.currency,
+    status: paymentIntent.status,
+    product_type: productType(metadata),
+    price_type: priceType(metadata),
+    ltv_multiplier: productType(metadata) === 'subscription' ? '12.0' : '1.0',
+    session_id: metadata.session_id ?? null,
+    offer_id: numberFrom(metadata, 'offer_id'),
+    variant_id: numberFrom(metadata, 'variant_id'),
+    test_id: numberFrom(metadata, 'test_id'),
+    utm_source: metadata.utm_source ?? null,
+    utm_medium: metadata.utm_medium ?? null,
+    utm_campaign: metadata.utm_campaign ?? null,
+    utm_content: metadata.utm_content ?? null,
+    utm_term: metadata.utm_term ?? null,
+    fbp: metadata.fbp ?? null,
+    fbc: metadata.fbc ?? null,
+    gclid: metadata.gclid ?? null,
+    ttclid: metadata.ttclid ?? null,
+    metadata,
+    stripe_created_at: createdAt(paymentIntent),
+  };
+}
+
+export async function recordPaymentIntentSucceeded(paymentIntent: Stripe.PaymentIntent): Promise<Result> {
+  if (!drizzleDb) return { handled: true, success: false, error: 'DB unavailable' };
+  const row = values(paymentIntent);
+  await drizzleDb.insert(stripe_payments).values(row).onConflictDoUpdate({
+    target: stripe_payments.stripe_payment_intent_id,
+    set: row,
+  });
+  return { handled: true, success: true };
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+import type Stripe from 'stripe';
+import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
+import { drizzleDb } from '../db/drizzleClient.js';
+import { customer_subscriptions } from '../db/drizzle/schema.js';
+import { pool } from '../db/pool.js';
+import { notifyPaidSubscriber } from './paidSubscriberNotification.js';
+import { getStripeClient } from './stripeClient.js';
+import { syncSubscriptionRecord } from './stripeSubscriptionRecord.js';
+import { completePaidUpsellSubscription } from './upsellSubscriptionCompletion.js';
+
+type Result = { handled: boolean; success: boolean; error?: string };
+
+function getInvoiceSubscriptionId(invoice: Stripe.Invoice): string | null {
+  const raw = invoice as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
+  const legacy = raw.subscription;
+  if (typeof legacy === 'string') return legacy;
+  const parent = raw.parent as Record<string, unknown> | null;
+  const details = parent?.subscription_details as Record<string, unknown> | null;
+  return typeof details?.subscription === 'string' ? details.subscription : null;
+}
+
+async function processPaidInvoice(invoice: Stripe.Invoice): Promise<Result> {
+  if (!pool) return { handled: true, success: false, error: 'DB unavailable' };
+  if (invoice.billing_reason !== 'subscription_create') return { handled: true, success: true };
+  const subscriptionId = getInvoiceSubscriptionId(invoice);
+  if (!subscriptionId) return { handled: true, success: false, error: 'Subscription missing' };
+  const stripe = getStripeClient();
+  const subscription = await stripe.subscriptions.retrieve(subscriptionId);
+  if (subscription.status !== 'active' && subscription.status !== 'trialing') {
+    return { handled: true, success: true };
+  }
+  const synced = await syncSubscriptionRecord(pool, stripe, subscription);
+  if (synced === null) return { handled: true, success: false, error: 'Sync failed' };
+  await completePaidUpsellSubscription(subscription);
+  const notified = await notifyPaidSubscriber(pool, stripe, subscription);
+  return { handled: true, success: notified, error: notified ? undefined : 'Alert pending' };
+}
+
+async function syncActiveSubscription(subscription: Stripe.Subscription): Promise<Result> {
+  if (!pool) return { handled: true, success: false, error: 'DB unavailable' };
+  if (subscription.status === 'incomplete' || subscription.status === 'incomplete_expired') {
+    return { handled: true, success: true };
+  }
+  const synced = await syncSubscriptionRecord(pool, getStripeClient(), subscription);
+  return { handled: true, success: synced !== null, error: synced === null ? 'Sync failed' : undefined };
+}
+
+async function markDeleted(subscription: Stripe.Subscription): Promise<Result> {
+  if (!drizzleDb) return { handled: true, success: false, error: 'DB unavailable' };
+  await drizzleDb.update(customer_subscriptions).set({
+    active: false,
+    available_for_routing: false,
+    status: 'canceled',
+    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
+  }).where(eq(customer_subscriptions.stripe_subscription_id, subscription.id));
+  return { handled: true, success: true };
+}
+
+export async function processSubscriptionStripeEvent(event: Stripe.Event): Promise<Result> {
+  if (event.type === 'invoice.paid') return processPaidInvoice(event.data.object as Stripe.Invoice);
+  if (event.type === 'customer.subscription.created' || event.type === 'customer.subscription.updated') {
+    return syncActiveSubscription(event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription);
+  }
+  if (event.type === 'customer.subscription.deleted') return markDeleted(event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription);
+  return { handled: false, success: true };
+}

+import { expect } from '@rstest/playwright';
+import type { Page, Response } from 'playwright';
+
+export type StreamEvent = {
+  kind: string; url: string; status: number; id?: string; amount?: number; success?: boolean;
+};
+
+const idFrom = (body: Record<string, unknown>, keys: string[]) => {
+  const found = keys.map((key) => body[key]).find((value) => typeof value === 'string');
+  return typeof found === 'string' ? found : undefined;
+};
+
+async function eventFrom(response: Response): Promise<StreamEvent | null> {
+  if (response.request().method() !== 'POST') return null;
+  const url = response.url();
+  let kind = '';
+  if (url.endsWith('/api/funnel/seamless-checkout/create-intent')) kind = 'checkout.intent';
+  if (url.endsWith('/api/stripe/confirm-payment')) kind = 'checkout.confirm';
+  if (url.endsWith('/api/stripe/subscribe-saved-method')) kind = 'stripe.subscription';
+  if (url.endsWith('/api/stripe/charge-saved-method')) kind = 'stripe.charge';
+  if (url.endsWith('/act')) kind = 'funnel.transition';
+  if (!kind) return null;
+  const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as Record<string, unknown>;
+  return {
+    kind, url, status: response.status(), success: body.success as boolean | undefined,
+    amount: typeof body.amount === 'number' ? body.amount : undefined,
+    id: idFrom(body, ['client_secret', 'payment_intent_id', 'subscription_id', 'charge_id']),
+  };
+}
+
+export function recordFunnelTransitionStream(page: Page): StreamEvent[] {
+  const events: StreamEvent[] = [];
+  page.on('response', (response) => {
+    void eventFrom(response).then((event) => { if (event) events.push(event); });
+  });
+  return events;
+}
+
+export async function clickDecline(page: Page, stepSlug: string): Promise<void> {
+  const action = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.url().endsWith(`/${stepSlug}/act`));
+  await page.locator('[data-component="decline_link"] a').first().click();
+  expect((await action).status()).toBe(200);
+}
+
+export async function acceptSubscription(page: Page, stepSlug: string): Promise<string> {
+  const subscribe = page.waitForResponse((response) =>
+    response.url().endsWith('/api/stripe/subscribe-saved-method'));
+  const action = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.url().endsWith(`/${stepSlug}/act`));
+  await page.locator('[data-offer-action="accept"]').first().click();
+  const response = await subscribe;
+  expect(response.status()).toBe(200);
+  const body = await response.json() as { success?: boolean; subscription_id?: string };
+  expect(body.success).toBe(true);
+  expect(body.subscription_id).toMatch(/^sub_/);
+  expect((await action).status()).toBe(200);
+  return body.subscription_id!;
+}
+
+export function expectStream(events: StreamEvent[]): void {
+  for (const event of events) expect(event.status, event.url).toBe(200);
+  const kinds = events.map((event) => event.kind);
+  expect(kinds.slice(0, 2)).toEqual(['checkout.intent', 'checkout.confirm']);
+  expect(kinds.filter((kind) => kind === 'funnel.transition').length)
+    .toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
+  const intent = events.find((event) => event.kind === 'checkout.intent');
+  expect(intent?.id).toMatch(/^pi_/);
+  expect(intent?.amount).toBe(1100);
+}

+import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
+import { promisify } from 'node:util';
+import { expect } from '@rstest/playwright';
+import type { Page } from 'playwright';
+import { captureRolloverStepProof } from './rolloverStepProof';
+
+const run = promisify(execFile);
+
+export type FinanceProof = {
+  paymentIntentId: string;
+  amountCents: number;
+  status: string;
+  rowId: string;
+  capturedAt: string;
+  screenshot: string;
+};
+
+function parseRows(stdout: string) {
+  return stdout.split('\n').filter((line) => /^\d+\s+\|/.test(line.trim()));
+}
+
+function rowValue(row: string, index: number) {
+  return row.split('|').map((part) => part.trim())[index] ?? '';
+}
+
+async function queryPayment(paymentIntentId: string) {
+  const sql = `SELECT id,stripe_payment_intent_id,amount_cents,status,created_at
+FROM stripe_payments WHERE stripe_payment_intent_id='${paymentIntentId}'`;
+  const { stdout } = await run('rustyroad', ['query', sql], { timeout: 20_000 });
+  const row = parseRows(stdout)[0];
+  if (!row) return null;
+  return {
+    rowId: rowValue(row, 0),
+    paymentIntentId: rowValue(row, 1),
+    amountCents: Number(rowValue(row, 2)),
+    status: rowValue(row, 3),
+    capturedAt: rowValue(row, 4),
+  };
+}
+
+async function waitForFinancePayment(paymentIntentId: string) {
+  const deadline = Date.now() + 90_000;
+  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
+    const row = await queryPayment(paymentIntentId);
+    if (row) return row;
+    await new Promise((resolve) => { setTimeout(resolve, 2_500); });
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+export async function captureStripeFinanceProof(
+  page: Page,
+  paymentIntentId: string,
+): Promise<FinanceProof> {
+  const row = await waitForFinancePayment(paymentIntentId);
+  expect(row, `stripe_payments row for ${paymentIntentId}`).toBeTruthy();
+  expect(row?.amountCents).toBe(1100);
+  expect(row?.status).toMatch(/succeeded|paid/i);
+  await page.setContent(`
+    <main style="font-family: system-ui; padding: 48px; color: #0f172a">
+      <p style="color:#047857;font-weight:700">Stripe webhook finance proof</p>
+      <h1>Payment persisted into app finances</h1>
+      <dl style="font-size:22px;line-height:1.7">
+        <dt>PaymentIntent</dt><dd>${row!.paymentIntentId}</dd>
+        <dt>Finance row</dt><dd>stripe_payments #${row!.rowId}</dd>
+        <dt>Total</dt><dd>$11.00 / ${row!.amountCents} cents</dd>
+        <dt>Status</dt><dd>${row!.status}</dd>
+        <dt>Captured at</dt><dd>${row!.capturedAt}</dd>
+      </dl>
+    </main>
+  `);
+  return { ...row!, screenshot: await captureRolloverStepProof(page, 'stripe-finance-webhook') };
+}

+name: Build Dev Fastify API Image
+

+

+  REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME: registry-quantum-forge-net-credentials

+jobs:
+  build-and-push-dev-api:

+    permissions:

+      NODE_ENV: development
+      ENVIRONMENT: dev
+      CI: 'true'
+      DOCKER_HOST: tcp://127.0.0.1:2375
+      DISABLE_STARTUP_INDEXES: 'true'
+      ENABLE_STARTUP_ROUTE_AWARENESS: 'false'
+      DISABLE_STARTUP_AB_ANALYTICS_REFRESH: 'true'
+      PLAYWRIGHT_APP_URL: http://localhost:8081
+      PLAYWRIGHT_AGENT_APP_URL: http://localhost:8081
+      PLAYWRIGHT_API_HOST: 127.0.0.1
+      PLAYWRIGHT_API_PORT: '8081'
+      PLAYWRIGHT_API_BASE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8081
+      CI_CACHE_SERVER: http://ci-cache-server.ci-cache.svc.cluster.local:8080
+      CI_CACHE_NAMESPACE: spotlessbinco-trusted-v5
+      CI_CACHE_COMPRESSION: zstd
+      CI_CACHE_ORPC_CONTRACT: /tmp/spotlessbinco-ci-cache-materialized/orpc-contract
+      CI_CACHE_API_ASSETS: /tmp/spotlessbinco-ci-cache-materialized/api-assets
+      CI_CACHE_PNPM_STORE: /tmp/spotlessbinco-ci-cache-materialized/pnpm/10.33.2
+      PLAYWRIGHT_API_CONTAINER: spotlessbinco-dev-api-integration
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          github-server-url: https://forgejo.quantum-forge.io
+          repository: ${{ inputs.checkout_repository || 'riley/spotlessbinco' }}
+          ref: ${{ inputs.checkout_ref || github.ref }}
+          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN || github.token }}
+          fetch-depth: 1
+
+      - name: Select reachable Cluster CI Cache service
+        uses: ./.forgejo/actions/setup-cluster-ci-cache
+
+      - name: Resolve API image tag
+        id: tag
+        run: |
+          short_sha="$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)"
+          tag="dev-${short_sha}"

+          echo "Fastify dev tag: $tag"

+        run: |
+          project="$REGISTRY_URL/spotlessbinco"

+            echo "API_IMAGE_REPO=$project/spotlessbinco-api"

+          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

+            -- 'config/database/migrations/**/*.sql' | grep -q .; then
+            echo "sql=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

+            echo "sql=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

+          fi
+
+      - name: Verify dev migration ledger (read-only)
+        if: steps.changes.outputs.sql == 'true'
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail

+          pending_migrations="$(
+            sed -n '/^[[:space:]]*{/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/migrations.raw" \

+          if [[ -n "$pending_migrations" ]]; then
+            echo "::error::Dev migrations are pending:" >&2

+            echo "::error::Apply each through the controlled migration workflow." >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          echo "Dev migration ledger is current; no schema writes were executed."
+
+      - name: Login to Quantum Forge registry
+        run: |
+          REGISTRY=${{ env.REGISTRY_URL }} \
+          REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME=${{ env.REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME }} \
+          REGISTRY_SECRET_NAMESPACES="spotlessbinco spotlessbinco-staging spotlessbinco-dev" \
+          scripts/vault-registry-login.sh
+   
+
+      - name: Prepare trusted Harbor BuildKit builder
+        uses: ./.forgejo/actions/setup-harbor-buildx
+
+      - name: Configure trusted API BuildKit cache
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          cache_key="spotlessbinco/api:buildcache-dev"
+          cache_from="$(ci-cache docker cache-from --key "$cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-from[ =]//")"
+          cache_to="$(ci-cache docker cache-to --key "$cache_key" | sed -E "s/^--cache-to[ =]//")"
+          {
+            echo "API_DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_FROM_IMAGE=type=registry,ref=${API_IMAGE_REPO}:dev"
+            echo "API_DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_FROM_BRANCH="
+            echo "API_DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_FROM_MAIN=${cache_from}"
+            echo "API_DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_TO=${cache_to}"

+
+      - name: Decide whether the published image can be reused

+

+          set -euo pipefail
+          # An ancestor commit with an identical packaged-input signature already
+          # has a published image, so retag that exact digest instead of
+          # rebuilding identical inputs. Promoting by digest keeps the released
+          # artifact byte-identical to the image that was already published.
+          source="${API_IMAGE_REPO}@${{ steps.reuse.outputs.source_digest }}"

+            "${API_IMAGE_REPO}:${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}" \

+          done

+            BUILDX_BUILDER=default timeout 20s docker buildx imagetools inspect \
+              "${API_IMAGE_REPO}:${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}" \
+              --format '{{json .Manifest}}' | jq -er '.digest'
+          )"

+      - name: Compute generated oRPC contract cache key

+          set -euo pipefail
+          echo "key=$(scripts/ci/orpc-contract-cache-key.sh)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Restore generated frontend SDK from trusted cluster cache
+        id: orpc_contract_restore
+        if: steps.reuse.outputs.reuse != 'true'

+          CACHE_KEY: ${{ steps.orpc_contract_key.outputs.key }}
+          CACHE_PATH: ${{ env.CI_CACHE_ORPC_CONTRACT }}
+          CI_CACHE_NAMESPACE: spotlessbinco-trusted-v5
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p "$CACHE_PATH"
+          restore_output="$RUNNER_TEMP/orpc-contract-restore.txt"

+            scripts/ci/restore-orpc-contract-cache.sh \
+            && grep -Eq '^RESTORED .*files=[1-9][0-9]*' "$restore_output" \

+            echo "cache-hit=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

+          fi

+
+      - name: Save pnpm store after frontend SDK regeneration setup
+        if: >-
+          steps.reuse.outputs.reuse != 'true' &&
+          steps.orpc_contract_restore.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' &&
+          env.CI_CACHE_PNPM_HIT != 'true'

+      - name: Regenerate frontend SDK from the checked-out revision
+        if: steps.reuse.outputs.reuse != 'true' && steps.orpc_contract_restore.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail

+          pnpm run generate-api-client:local-file

+

+        if: steps.reuse.outputs.reuse != 'true' && steps.orpc_contract_restore.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
+        env:

+
+
+

+        env:
+          CI_CACHE_NAMESPACE: spotlessbinco-trusted-v5
+        uses: ./.forgejo/actions/cluster-directory-cache

+
+      - name: Create isolated integration runtime environment
+        if: steps.reuse.outputs.reuse != 'true'
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          integration_config="$RUNNER_TEMP/api-integration-rustyroad.toml"

+          # The host Rstest process resolves its database through the RustyRoad

+            return configured;

+          const password = encodeURIComponent(value('database_password'));
+          const host = value('database_host');
+          const port = value('database_port');
+          const database = encodeURIComponent(value('database_name'));

+            'ENVIRONMENT=test',
+            'HOST=0.0.0.0',
+            'PORT=8081',
+            'API_PORT=8081',

+name: Build Dev Rust Image
+
+# Called by deploy-dev.yml and production-candidate.yml for trusted dev Rust image builds.
+on:
+  workflow_call:
+    inputs:
+      checkout_repository:
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+      checkout_ref:
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: ''
+      rust_binary_cargo_version:
+        description: Exact cargo --version used to publish the binary cache
+        required: true
+        type: string
+      rust_binary_rustc_version:
+        description: Exact rustc -vV used to publish the binary cache
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+concurrency:
+  # One trusted writer owns the mutable dev cache ref.
+  group: dev-rust-cache
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+env:
+  REGISTRY_URL: registry.quantum-forge.net
+  REGISTRY_SECRET_NAME: registry-quantum-forge-net-credentials
+  SEMANTIC_TAG: dev-${{ github.sha }}
+
+jobs:
+  build-and-push:
+    runs-on: spotlessbinco-k8s-dind-privileged
+    timeout-minutes: 90
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      id-token: write
+    env:
+      NODE_ENV: development
+      ENVIRONMENT: dev
+      CI: 'true'
+      DOCKER_HOST: tcp://127.0.0.1:2375
+      CI_CACHE_SERVER: http://ci-cache-server.ci-cache.svc.cluster.local:8080
+      CI_CACHE_NAMESPACE: spotlessbinco-dev-v5
+      CI_CACHE_COMPRESSION: zstd
+      RUST_BINARY_CARGO_VERSION: ${{ inputs.rust_binary_cargo_version }}
+      RUST_BINARY_RUSTC_VERSION: ${{ inputs.rust_binary_rustc_version }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          github-server-url: https://forgejo.quantum-forge.io
+          repository: ${{ inputs.checkout_repository || 'riley/spotlessbinco' }}
+          ref: ${{ inputs.checkout_ref || github.ref }}
+          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN || github.token }}
+          fetch-depth: 1
+      - name: Resolve backend image tag

+import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';

+  exterior_quote_photosRepository,
+  exterior_quote_requestsRepository,
+  exterior_quote_surfacesRepository,
+} from '../db/drizzle/client.js';
+import { exterior_quote_requests } from '../db/drizzle/schema.js';
+import type { DrizzleDatabase } from '../db/drizzleDatabase.js';

+
+type Surface = ReturnType<typeof import('./selectedPackageSurfaces.js').selectedPackageSurfaces>[number];
+type Photo = InstantQuoteInput['photos'][number];
+
+export async function findQuoteBySourceKey(db: DrizzleDatabase, sourceKey: string): Promise<QuotePersistenceResult | null> {
+  const [row] = await db.select({
+    id: exterior_quote_requests.id,
+    publicToken: exterior_quote_requests.public_token,
+  }).from(exterior_quote_requests)
+    .where(eq(exterior_quote_requests.source_key, sourceKey)).limit(1);
+  return row ? { id: Number(row.id), publicToken: row.publicToken, created: false } : null;
+}
+
+export async function insertQuoteRequest(
+  db: DrizzleDatabase,
+  input: InstantQuoteInput,
+  quote: InstantQuoteOutput,
+  sourceKey: string | null,
+): Promise<QuotePersistenceResult> {
+  if (!sourceKey) {
+    const row = await exterior_quote_requestsRepository.create(db, quoteRequestValues(input, quote, null));
+    return { id: row.id, publicToken: row.public_token, created: true };
+  }
+  const [row] = await db.insert(exterior_quote_requests)
+    .values(quoteRequestValues(input, quote, sourceKey))
+    .onConflictDoNothing({ target: exterior_quote_requests.source_key })
+    .returning({ id: exterior_quote_requests.id, publicToken: exterior_quote_requests.public_token });
+  return row ? { ...row, created: true } : await requireQuoteBySourceKey(db, sourceKey);
+}
+
+function quoteRequestValues(input: InstantQuoteInput, quote: InstantQuoteOutput, sourceKey: string | null) {
+  return {
+    first_name: input.contact.firstName ?? null, last_name: input.contact.lastName ?? null,
+    email: input.contact.email ?? null, phone: input.contact.phone,
+    line1: input.address.line1 ?? null, line2: input.address.line2 ?? null,

+    postal_code: input.address.postalCode, problem_type: input.problemType,
+    status: quote.status, service_area: quote.serviceArea,
+    total_price_cents: quote.totalPriceCents,
+    line_items: quote.lineItems as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
+    blockers: quote.blockers, source_key: sourceKey,
+  };
+}
+
+async function requireQuoteBySourceKey(db: DrizzleDatabase, sourceKey: string): Promise<QuotePersistenceResult> {
+  const existing = await findQuoteBySourceKey(db, sourceKey);
+  if (existing) return existing;
+  throw new Error('Exterior quote source key conflict did not return an existing quote.');
+}

+export async function insertQuoteScope(
+  db: DrizzleDatabase,
+  quoteRequestId: number,
+  surfaces: Surface[],
+  photos: Photo[],
+): Promise<void> {
+  await Promise.all(surfaces.map((surface) => exterior_quote_surfacesRepository.create(db, {
+    quote_request_id: quoteRequestId, surface_type: surface.surfaceType,
+    size_sqft: surface.sizeSqft ?? null, quantity: surface.quantity ?? null,
+    stain_types: surface.stainTypes, risk_flags: surface.riskFlags,
+  })));
+  await Promise.all(photos.map((photo) => exterior_quote_photosRepository.create(db, {
+    quote_request_id: quoteRequestId, photo_type: photo.photoType, photo_url: photo.url,
+  })));
+}

+import type Stripe from 'stripe';
+import { drizzleDb } from '../db/drizzleClient.js';
+import { stripe_payments } from '../db/drizzle/schema.js';
+
+type Result = { handled: boolean; success: boolean; error?: string };
+type Metadata = Record<string, string>;
+
+function textId(value: string | { id?: string } | null | undefined) {
+  if (typeof value === 'string') return value;
+  return typeof value?.id === 'string' ? value.id : null;
+}
+
+function numberFrom(metadata: Metadata, key: string) {
+  const value = metadata[key];
+  if (!value) return null;
+  const parsed = Number.parseInt(value, 10);
+  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
+}
+
+function productType(metadata: Metadata) {
+  return metadata.product_type ?? metadata.productType ?? 'one_time';
+}
+
+function priceType(metadata: Metadata) {
+  return metadata.price_type ?? (productType(metadata) === 'subscription' ? 'recurring' : 'one_time');
+}
+
+function createdAt(paymentIntent: Stripe.PaymentIntent) {
+  return new Date(paymentIntent.created * 1000).toISOString();
+}
+
+function values(paymentIntent: Stripe.PaymentIntent) {
+  const metadata = paymentIntent.metadata ?? {};
+  const amount = paymentIntent.amount_received || paymentIntent.amount;
+  return {
+    stripe_payment_intent_id: paymentIntent.id,
+    stripe_customer_id: textId(paymentIntent.customer),
+    stripe_charge_id: textId(paymentIntent.latest_charge),
+    stripe_checkout_session_id: metadata.checkout_session_id ?? null,
+    amount_cents: amount,
+    amount_refunded_cents: 0,
+    currency: paymentIntent.currency,
+    status: paymentIntent.status,
+    product_type: productType(metadata),
+    price_type: priceType(metadata),
+    ltv_multiplier: productType(metadata) === 'subscription' ? '12.0' : '1.0',
+    session_id: metadata.session_id ?? null,
+    offer_id: numberFrom(metadata, 'offer_id'),
+    variant_id: numberFrom(metadata, 'variant_id'),
+    test_id: numberFrom(metadata, 'test_id'),
+    utm_source: metadata.utm_source ?? null,
+    utm_medium: metadata.utm_medium ?? null,
+    utm_campaign: metadata.utm_campaign ?? null,
+    utm_content: metadata.utm_content ?? null,
+    utm_term: metadata.utm_term ?? null,
+    fbp: metadata.fbp ?? null,
+    fbc: metadata.fbc ?? null,
+    gclid: metadata.gclid ?? null,
+    ttclid: metadata.ttclid ?? null,
+    metadata,
+    stripe_created_at: createdAt(paymentIntent),
+  };
+}
+
+export async function recordPaymentIntentSucceeded(paymentIntent: Stripe.PaymentIntent): Promise<Result> {
+  if (!drizzleDb) return { handled: true, success: false, error: 'DB unavailable' };
+  const row = values(paymentIntent);
+  await drizzleDb.insert(stripe_payments).values(row).onConflictDoUpdate({
+    target: stripe_payments.stripe_payment_intent_id,
+    set: row,
+  });
+  return { handled: true, success: true };
+}

+import type Stripe from 'stripe';
+import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
+import { drizzleDb } from '../db/drizzleClient.js';
+import { customer_subscriptions } from '../db/drizzle/schema.js';
+import { pool } from '../db/pool.js';
+import { notifyPaidSubscriber } from './paidSubscriberNotification.js';
+import { getStripeClient } from './stripeClient.js';
+import { syncSubscriptionRecord } from './stripeSubscriptionRecord.js';
+import { completePaidUpsellSubscription } from './upsellSubscriptionCompletion.js';
+
+type Result = { handled: boolean; success: boolean; error?: string };
+
+function getInvoiceSubscriptionId(invoice: Stripe.Invoice): string | null {
+  const raw = invoice as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
+  const legacy = raw.subscription;
+  if (typeof legacy === 'string') return legacy;
+  const parent = raw.parent as Record<string, unknown> | null;
+  const details = parent?.subscription_details as Record<string, unknown> | null;
+  return typeof details?.subscription === 'string' ? details.subscription : null;
+}
+
+async function processPaidInvoice(invoice: Stripe.Invoice): Promise<Result> {
+  if (!pool) return { handled: true, success: false, error: 'DB unavailable' };
+  if (invoice.billing_reason !== 'subscription_create') return { handled: true, success: true };
+  const subscriptionId = getInvoiceSubscriptionId(invoice);
+  if (!subscriptionId) return { handled: true, success: false, error: 'Subscription missing' };
+  const stripe = getStripeClient();
+  const subscription = await stripe.subscriptions.retrieve(subscriptionId);
+  if (subscription.status !== 'active' && subscription.status !== 'trialing') {
+    return { handled: true, success: true };
+  }
+  const synced = await syncSubscriptionRecord(pool, stripe, subscription);
+  if (synced === null) return { handled: true, success: false, error: 'Sync failed' };
+  await completePaidUpsellSubscription(subscription);
+  const notified = await notifyPaidSubscriber(pool, stripe, subscription);
+  return { handled: true, success: notified, error: notified ? undefined : 'Alert pending' };
+}
+
+async function syncActiveSubscription(subscription: Stripe.Subscription): Promise<Result> {
+  if (!pool) return { handled: true, success: false, error: 'DB unavailable' };
+  if (subscription.status === 'incomplete' || subscription.status === 'incomplete_expired') {
+    return { handled: true, success: true };
+  }
+  const synced = await syncSubscriptionRecord(pool, getStripeClient(), subscription);
+  return { handled: true, success: synced !== null, error: synced === null ? 'Sync failed' : undefined };
+}
+
+async function markDeleted(subscription: Stripe.Subscription): Promise<Result> {
+  if (!drizzleDb) return { handled: true, success: false, error: 'DB unavailable' };
+  await drizzleDb.update(customer_subscriptions).set({
+    active: false,
+    available_for_routing: false,
+    status: 'canceled',
+    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
+  }).where(eq(customer_subscriptions.stripe_subscription_id, subscription.id));
+  return { handled: true, success: true };
+}
+
+export async function processSubscriptionStripeEvent(event: Stripe.Event): Promise<Result> {
+  if (event.type === 'invoice.paid') return processPaidInvoice(event.data.object as Stripe.Invoice);
+  if (event.type === 'customer.subscription.created' || event.type === 'customer.subscription.updated') {
+    return syncActiveSubscription(event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription);
+  }
+  if (event.type === 'customer.subscription.deleted') return markDeleted(event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription);
+  return { handled: false, success: true };
+}
